title: Advanced Berry Breeding - Varieties
summary: Advanced Berry Breeding's own variety list contains raspberry cultivars only: Zawadi, Sarafina, Rafiki, Baridi and Shani, alongside Malaika and Kwanza elsewhere on the site. No blueberry cultivar appears.
why_it_matters: Recorded as negative evidence. The premise that Advanced Berry Breeding is a blueberry breeder is not supported by its own variety list or by its owner's description of it. Documenting the absence prevents a phantom competitor from entering the dataset.

reading.rationale: Short but it removes an entity from blueberry contention.

monitoring.rationale: Re-check only if a blueberry programme is announced.
